work.title: Prime Knots with Augmentation-Rank Gaps at Unbounded Bridge Number
work.abstract: We construct explicit braid families containing infinitely many distinct hyperbolic prime knots of each bridge number \(b=5,6\) and each sufficiently large \(b\), with complex augmentation rank at most \(b-1\) and meridional rank \(b\). Alternating-group colorings force \(b\) meridional generators, while two fixed meridian words let a local rank-one obstruction persist as the braid grows. An oriented diagram isotopy realizes the associated two-cusped exteriors as fillings of a single three-cusped exterior. Rigorous interval certificates establish hyperbolicity of that exterior and the two small-bridge exteriors used in the filling argument.
